text:
Maria: Quick check — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy before we push to Webflow? Need final CTA routing + a short benchmark blurb and webinar RSVP included. Thinking separate CTAs per tier: 'Try Hosted', 'Reserve Dedicated', 'Talk Private'. Any objections?

Kevin: No objections. Agree on separate CTAs. Key messaging priorities: Hosted = fastest time-to-value; Dedicated = predictable throughput & SLAs; Private = security/compliance + VPC. We should keep hero lines short and follow with a one-sentence value props band.

Sophie: Friendly FYI — I drafted two hero variants for review. Variant A (enterprise-forward):
  - "Production-grade LLM inference, anywhere you run it."
  - subhead: "Hosted for speed. Dedicated for scale. Private for control and compliance."
Variant B (developer-first):
  - "Ship LLM features that stay fast and cheap in production."
  - subhead: "Same API. Pick hosted, dedicated, or private deployments."
Which tone do we want for the site? B skews product-led growth. A is more enterprise-trust.

Ryan: For the benchmark blurb, propose: "Benchmarks: <model> @ p99 latency on 8k context — 60ms on Dedicated; X% cost reduction vs baseline with caching + quantization." Keep it short and link to a longer benchmarks page. Also recommend a line above CTA: 'See detailed benchmarks and sign up for the webinar'. Webinar RSVP should be a modal that sets utm_campaign=webinar_launch.

Dan: Routing notes from engineering: we can implement CTA routing two ways — path-based or query-based. Path-based example: `/cta/hosted` -> routes to /signup?plan=hosted ; `/cta/dedicated` -> /contact?plan=dedicated . Query-based example with UTM: `/signup?plan=hosted&utm_source=site&utm_campaign=hero_launch`

Jules: I'll implement Webflow redirects. Prefer path-based for cleaner analytics. I can add a 50/50 split test between Sophie A/B hero variants using a cookie flag. Need copy freeze by Friday EOD to get QA before Tuesday deploy.

Maria: Proposed tasks: Kevin — finalize microcopy + one-sentence band for each tier. Sophie — prepare A/B hero art + alt hero microcopy. Ryan — finalize benchmark copy and create webinar landing page (include registration link + utm template). Jules — implement Webflow redirects & A/B test. Dan — add server-side fallback redirect for non-JS clients and add short test route.

Kevin: Working on final microcopy now. Draft for hero CTAs: Hosted: "Start free"; Dedicated: "Reserve capacity"; Private: "Request demo". Thoughts on CTAs?

Sophie: I prefer CTAs that align to funnel stage — 'Start free' (Hosted), 'Get pricing' (Dedicated), 'Talk to sales' (Private). 'Request demo' sounds salesy for Private but ok.

Maria: Let's use Sophie's CTAs. Kevin pls update the copy doc and drop final lines in the same doc. Ryan — once webinar page is live, share link & I'll add to the hero band.

Ryan: Will do. For tracking, using `?utm_source=site&utm_medium=hero&utm_campaign=launch_q2` and webinar link will append `&utm_campaign=webinar_launch` when routed from the modal.

Dan: Quick note — sample redirect rule I can add to nginx if needed:

```
location = /cta/hosted { return 302 /signup?plan=hosted&utm_source=site&utm_campaign=launch_q2; }
location = /cta/dedicated { return 302 /contact?plan=dedicated&utm_source=site&utm_campaign=launch_q2; }
```

Jules: Copy freeze Friday EOD. I'll queue the A/B test and do a quick QA pass on Monday morning.

Maria: Great. Final checklist: 1) Copy doc updated (Kevin) 2) Hero assets (Sophie) 3) Webinar page + UTMs (Ryan) 4) Webflow redirects + A/B (Jules) 5) Server fallback + test routes (Dan). Ping me here when done. :thumbsup:

Ryan: I'll post the webinar RSVP URL in this thread when ready.

Kevin: Dropping final microcopy in the doc now — link: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketing/landing-copy-v3 (please check tone and CTAs).

Sophie: Reviewing copy in doc, minor spacing edits done.

Jules: Putting staging build up after copy freeze. Will flag any layout issues.

Maria: Thanks team — aiming to go live next Wednesday. If anything blocks, shout here and we'll re-prioritize. :rocket:
